nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data based on a query derived from a short message.

A method of determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources providing that type, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to a specified parameter.
A classification of context data determined algorithmically from the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about the environment or context of the mobile device.
A provider that supplies context data of a given context-data type; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

A message content to which relevant context-data is linked and formatted according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms are analyzed to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, or forwarded along with the short message.
A device such as a smart phone that generates a short message and a query; context data may be provided to the device that generated the message or to a recipient mobile device.

A computing device associated with a context-data provider that collects context-data.<SEP>A computing system that receives short messages from mobile devices, determines context-data types, identifies and ranks context-data sources, and generates requests for context data.

A criterion used to rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.
A mobile device that receives context data, possibly associated with or appended to a short message, or receives a URI of a database server and metadata instructions to query the database.
A storage system available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored, accessible via a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to allow access to stored context data.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute operations for context-data acquisition and ranking.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method of context-data acquisition and ranking.
A device by which the context-data is obtained.<SEP>A sensor by which context data related to the meaning of short message content is obtained.

An entity with at least one server that collects and provides context-data, and is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a set of context data related to the meaning of short message content is collected by at least one server.

A measure used to algorithmically select relevant context-data, comprising a monetary cost of the context-data.<SEP>A criterion used to algorithmically select relevant context data, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
Data related to the meaning of a short message content, obtained by a physical sensor and provided by context-data providers, weighted according to at least one metric including monetary cost.
A protocol according to which the relevant context-data and short message are formatted; may comprise a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context-data and short message.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context-data and short message.
The cost of the context-data, used as a metric for selecting relevant context-data.
The device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context-data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method algorithmically determines a context-data type from the meaning of a term of a short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type, ranks the source according to a specified parameter, and generates a request for context data from the source.
The method receives a short message and may associate, append, encode, or forward received context data with the short message.
The method provides received context data to the mobile device that generated the short message or to a recipient mobile device.
The method is performed with a server that receives short messages and manages context-data acquisition.
The method ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, device state, or network state.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The computerized apparatus performs operations of context-data acquisition and ranking via processor-executed program instructions.
A computer readable medium comprises computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.
A set of context data related to the meaning of short message content is collected from at least one context-data provider with at least one server.
Relevant context data is algorithmically selected according to a metric comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
The context data is obtained by a physical sensor.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data type provides information about the environment or context of the mobile device.
The context-data source is ranked according to a specified parameter comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data.
The server generates a request for context data of the context-data type from the context-data source.
The metric comprises a monetary cost of the context data provided by the context-data source.
The short message is received from and generated by a mobile device.
The server receives a short message from a mobile device.
The context-data is related to the meaning of the short message content and relevant context-data is linked to the short message.
The relevant context-data and the short message are formatted according to a communication protocol.
The short message is generated by the device whose physical context the context-data relates to.
The context-data provider collects context-data with at least one server.<SEP>A set of context data is collected from the context-data provider with at least one server.
The recipient mobile device has access to a database storing received context data.
The receiving mobile device receives a forwarded Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server.
The computerized apparatus comprises at least one memory having program instructions and at least one processor.
The context-data is obtained by a physical sensor.
The context-data provider, with at least one server, collects and provides a set of context-data.
The context-data provider is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.
The metric comprises a monetary cost of the context-data.
Relevant context-data is algorithmically selected according to a metric, and context-data elements are weighted according to at least one metric.
The context-data is related to a physical context of the device that generated the short message.
The communication protocol may comprise a cellular network short message protocol.
The communication protocol may comprise an internet communication protocol.
